snippet.title: Trust Me, I Nailed It - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Trust Me, I Nailed It will be released on 5 February 2026 for FREE.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4311000/Trust_Me_I_Nailed_It/

Trust Me, I Nailed It is a turn-based strategy game where you edit video clips to make a screwed up warrior into a monster-slaying legend. Edit, stitch, and fake your way to epic battle videos. Make every fight look like a glorious win. 

Developer: Team Afternoon
X: https://x.com/TeamAftern1104

#indiegame #strategy #freetoplay
